fact: Tunisie Telecom's Data Center Carthage, in service since 2014, is dedicated to colocation, cloud computing and cybersecurity services and was certified ISO 27001, 27701 and 9001 after a TÜV Rheinland audit.
title: Tunisie Telecom certifie son Data Center Carthage selon les normes ISO 27001, 27701 et 9001
